captureAndClassification.captureRule: Before inference, record post URL/identifier, displayed author handle, displayed date, query, media type, exact image/frame index and directly visible facts.
captureAndClassification.observed: Only directly visible signage, geometry, adjacency, surface and route continuity.
captureAndClassification.inferred: Any candidate-way binding or road disposition inferred from the visible evidence; include confidence and cited controls.
captureAndClassification.unknown: Any member, boundary, surface, width, cover, access or footprint fact not resolved by the captured evidence.
captureAndClassification.publicityBoundary: Open public community is a usage or planning objective only; it never upgrades an OSM member binding or road-surface fact.
